description: C# models for deserializing TITL PDF Processor API responses. Supports document extraction for deeds, mortgages, liens, title commitments, and 20+ property document types.
releaseNotes:
v3.5.0 (August 2026) — additive (TSS export schema 2.7.0, tax reader coverage and billed-vs-owing)
- TssExportSchema.Version is now 2.7.0, catching the SDK up across 2.5.0, 2.6.0 and
  2.7.0 in one release. Backward compatible with 2.4.0 and earlier: every addition
  below is optional and existing v3.4.0 consumers that ignore them keep working.
- Added TssTaxYear.AmountBilled (contract 2.6.0) — the total levied for the year, as issued, distinct
  from AmountDue. A county printing both a billing statement and an account summary
  states the levy on the former and the remaining balance on the latter, so a settled
  bill now reads AmountBilled = 5304.27 with AmountDue = 0. Previously the levied
  figure had nowhere to go and a paid bill reported only the zero. Where a source
  states a single figure — the common case, and every abstractor template — that
  figure is reported as both (TITL-2389).
- Added TssTaxReconciliation.Suppressed (contract 2.5.0) — records found in a tax-bearing section and
  deliberately not reported as tax years, with the reason. A withheld record is one
  asserting no monetary fact: the shape an unfilled tax section on an abstractor's
  form takes, and the shape a county-wide delinquency listing takes when its rows
  would otherwise be read as the subject's. Stating the withholding rather than
  dropping it silently is what lets a reader tell "the source stated no tax figures"
  from "no tax page was found" (TITL-2382).
- Added TssTaxReconciliation.Coverage (contract 2.7.0, List<TssTaxCoverageGap>) and the
  TssTaxCoverageGap type (Section, Pages, Reason, Rows) — which tax sections a named
  reader claimed and which it did not. A "last_resort" entry means the section was
  read only by the generic per-row reader, which knows nothing of the jurisdiction's
  bill structure and so cannot group rows into bills; "unclaimed" means tax-shaped
  rows were present and nothing read them. A format we do not properly support
  becomes a queryable record rather than a partner escalation. Sections are named by
  heading and page rather than by section type, because two runs of the same file can
  assign different types to the same page (TITL-2383).
- Fixed: the contract-test sample response was pinned at schemaVersion 2.3.0 while
  TssExportSchema.Version read 2.4.0, so the export deserialization test asserted a
  mismatch. Both now read 2.7.0. The break went unnoticed because the .NET contract
  tests run only at publish time and no publish was attempted in that window
  (TITL-2428).

v3.4.0 (August 2026) — additive (TSS export schema 2.4.0, tax reporting on Maryland levies)
- TssExportSchema.Version is now 2.4.0. Backward compatible with 2.3.0 and earlier.
- Added TssTaxYear.PaymentSchedule (TssTaxPaymentSchedule) — the payment cadences a
  bill offers. A set, not a single value: a Baltimore City levy prints both a
  SEMIANNUAL and an ANNUAL PAYMENT SCHEDULE block, so the bill offers two rather
  than declaring one. Null when the source prints no schedule. Which cadence the
  taxpayer elected is not reported — a bill settled in two semiannual payments
  whose breakdown was never printed cannot be distinguished from one settled
  annually.
- Added TssTaxYear.AmountAssessed — the assessment a bill was computed on, read
  from the levy's own line items when its authority rows agree. Distinct from
  TssTaxSummary.AssessedValue, which is the assessor's land / building valuation.
- Behavior: a package stacking several annual levies now reports one tax year per
  levy instead of merging them, and reports each levy's own payment. A Maryland
  fiscal period is labeled by its closing year, matching the jurisdiction.
- Behavior: assessed values are read from the assessor's grid in preference to a
  bill's basis, and a phase-in total is no longer reported as the assessed value.
- Non-breaking: existing v3.3.0 consumers ignore the new optional members.

v3.3.0 (July 2026) — additive (TSS export schema 2.3.0, RezLink Taxes-tab wire-up, TITL-1870 / TITL-1871)
- TssExportSchema.Version is now 2.3.0. Backward compatible with 2.2.0 / 2.1.0 / 2.0.0.
- Added TitleSearchSummaryExport.EffectiveDate — the examiner's examined-through /
  effective date at the export root (the date through which the search results are
  good). Mirrors ExaminerConclusion.EffectiveDate so a consumer can bind it directly
  for the "Property Information + Effective Date" section without descending into the
  examiner block. Null when unresolved (TITL-1870).
- Added TssTaxYear.ParcelId — the Tax ID / parcel a tax record belongs to, so a
  multi-parcel package renders one grid row per parcel-year and each row can be
  labeled with its Tax ID (the package-level union stays on TssTaxSummary.ParcelIds).
- Added TssTaxYear.DelinquentDate — the date a tax became delinquent when stated.
- Added TssTaxYear.ResponsibleParty — the owner / taxpayer of record for the tax
  when the source names one. These three back the RezLink Taxes grid (TITL-1871).
- Behavior: reconciliation conflicts are now scoped per (parcelId, taxYear), so a
  multi-parcel package whose parcels carry distinct amounts for the same year is no
  longer flagged as a conflict.
- Non-breaking: existing v3.2.0 consumers ignore the new optional members; all
  previously populated fields are unchanged.

v3.2.0 (July 2026) — additive (TSS export schema 2.2.0, RezLink SoftPro wire-up, TITL-1673)
- TssExportSchema.Version is now 2.2.0. Backward compatible with 2.1.0 / 2.0.0.
- Added TssTaxYear.PaidDate — the date a tax year was paid when the source
  reports one (e.g. a county e-tax portal "Paid Date" / "Paid in Full" column).
  Null when the source does not report a payment date. Lets a consumer show the
  settlement date alongside amountPaid without inferring it from status.
- Behavior: county property-tax tables (Wake County e-tax and similar) are now
  parsed into taxSummary.years with per-year status / amountPaid / amountDue /
  paidDate, instead of being dropped as unstructured text (TITL-1673).
- Non-breaking: existing v3.1.0 / v3.0.0 consumers ignore the new optional
  member; all previously populated tax fields are unchanged.

v3.1.0 (July 2026) — additive (TSS export schema 2.1.0, RezLink 7/7 audit, TITL-1557)
- TssExportSchema.Version is now 2.1.0. Backward compatible with 2.0.0.
- Added TitleSearchSummaryExport.PropertyInfo (TssPropertyInfo) — the subject
  property the package was searched for (Address, ParcelIds, LegalDescription,
  SearchCriteria, Evidence). Lets a consumer confirm the runsheet was run for the
  intended parcel. Null when no identifier was found (TITL-1558).
- Added TssRunsheetEntry.InstrumentTypeRaw — the verbatim instrument-type string
  as read. InstrumentType is now canonicalized (mapped label, or "UNKNOWN" when a
  value was read but unrecognizable); the raw is always preserved when read so a
  consumer can build their own extended acronym library (TITL-1560).
- Added TssRunsheetEntry.NormalizedFields (TssRunsheetNormalizedFields) — mirrors
  each runsheet row in the same vocabulary as documents[].normalizedFields
  (first_party, second_party, content_type, document_date, recorded_date,
  book_page, instrument_number) so one SoftPro mapping path serves both (TITL-1559).
- Non-breaking: existing v3.0.0 consumers ignore the new optional members;
  Grantor / Grantee / InstrumentType remain populated.

v3.0.0 (June 2026) — BREAKING (TSS export schema 2.0.0, ADR-030)
- TssExportSchema.Version is now 2.0.0.
- BREAKING: TitleSearchSummaryExport.ChainOfTitle is removed and replaced by a
  single Runsheet (List<TssRunsheetEntry>) — the superset of every instrument
  tied to the property (deeds, mortgages, liens, releases, easements, ...), each
  tagged Present + Corroboration with per-evidence provenance. The processor does
  NOT derive a chain of title (the connected grantor->grantee ownership subset);
  deriving the chain from the runsheet is the consumer's responsibility.
- BREAKING: type TssChainOfTitleEntry renamed to TssRunsheetEntry (entry fields
  unchanged: Present, Corroboration, Position, evidence, etc.).
- BREAKING: TssExportCompleteness.HasChainOfTitle renamed to HasRunsheet.
- BREAKING: TssExportCompleteness.ChainGapCount renamed to ReferenceOnlyCount
  ("gap" dropped — it implied chain continuity the processor does not assert).
- Behavior: non-conveyance instruments (mortgages, releases, liens, easements)
  that were previously withheld from ChainOfTitle now appear in Runsheet, with
  Present=true and Corroboration corroborated/uncorroborated when a copy is in the
  package. Search work-products (TSS, runsheet, commitment), tax, parcel, and
  informational documents are not runsheet rows.
- Migration: rename ChainOfTitle -> Runsheet, HasChainOfTitle -> HasRunsheet,
  ChainGapCount -> ReferenceOnlyCount; TssChainOfTitleEntry -> TssRunsheetEntry.

v2.13.0 (June 2026) — superseded by 3.0.0, never published separately
- Additive (ADR-030, schema 1.2.0): Present (bool?) and Corroboration
  ("corroborated" | "reference-only" | "uncorroborated") on the runsheet entry.
  Entries are seeded from instrument documents physically present in the package
  (the implicit runsheet) and reconciled against indexed references; colliding
  sources corroborate (evidence merges) rather than being dropped.
- Additive: ChainGapCount on completeness (later renamed ReferenceOnlyCount in 3.0.0).
- Additive (ADR-029): ReadEngine ("documentai" | "gemini-vision", nullable) on
  TssEvidenceRef — the OCR-engine provenance axis. Omitted defaults to documentai.
  These changes shipped in the models but were never released under their own
  version; they are rolled into 3.0.0.

v2.12.0 (June 2026)
- Bumped TssExportSchema.Version to 1.1.0 (additive, backward compatible with 1.0.0)
- TssComplianceSearch.ResultCount (candidate match count for OFAC/Patriot searches)
  is now part of the formal 1.1.0 TSS export schema; the field already shipped in
  v2.11.0 so existing consumers require no code changes
- Expanded TSS population coverage upstream: state-court/Case.net name searches,
  CT field-per-section parcel aggregation, multi-entry OFAC searches, lowercase-keyed
  tax records, and CT transaction-history/instrument-reference chain rows (no SDK
  shape changes)

v2.11.0 (June 2026)
- Added TitleSearchSummaryExport and member types for normalized TSS export (TITL-1330)
- Added titleSearchSummary on JobResponse (GET /jobs/:id) and JobResults (persisted results)
- Added TssExportSchema.Version constant (1.0.0)
- Sample response and contract test for shell-phase TSS export

v2.10.0 (April 2026)
- Added normalizedFields.address_components (AddressComponents) — structured US address fields derived server-side from address (TITL-779)

v2.9.0 (April 2026)
- Normalized JUDGEMENT → JUDGMENT as the canonical document type (TITL-606)
- Added IsJudgment() helper method (checks DataType == "JUDGMENT")
- Deprecated IsJudgement() with [Obsolete] attribute — still works for both spellings
- Updated sample responses and contract tests for JUDGMENT

v2.8.0 (April 2026)
- Added AddressAnalysis to JobResults for cross-document address comparison (TITL-598)
- AddressAnalysis includes: UniqueAddresses, MultipleAddressesDetected, Comparisons
- Legal descriptions (lot/plat/subdivision references) are now filtered from address analysis
- Added AddressSource, AddressDocumentSource, AddressComparison classes
- Added HasMultipleProperties() and GetUniqueAddresses() helper methods on JobResults
- Non-breaking: existing v2.7.0 consumers will ignore the new optional field

v2.7.0 (March 2026)
- Added NormalizedFields to all structured extractions (first_party, second_party, document_date, etc.)
- Added RELEASE document type (satisfaction of mortgage, full reconveyance, release of lien)
- Added IsRelease() helper method
- Added ReleaseExtraction interface with fields matching release.md prompt
- Aligned extraction interfaces with AI prompts:
  - MORTGAGE: loan_amount → principal_amount
  - LIEN: debtor_name → property_owner
  - TAX_STATEMENT: fully restructured (owner_name → property_owner, parcel_number → parcel_id, etc.)
- Deprecated old field constants with [Obsolete] attributes (DebtorName, ParcelNumber, etc.)
- Added new StructuredFieldNames: PrincipalAmount, ParcelId, TotalAssessedValue, TotalTaxDue, etc.

v2.6.0 (February 2026)
- BREAKING: schedule_a_coverage and schedule_b_exceptions are now structured arrays (TITL-212)
- Added ScheduleAItem class (label, value) for Schedule A coverage terms
- Added ScheduleBExceptionItem class (description, type) for Schedule B exceptions
- Added GetScheduleACoverage() and GetScheduleBExceptions() helper methods
- Updated sample responses and contract tests

v2.5.0 (January 2026)
- Added PARTIAL_RELEASE, SECURITY_DEED, DEED_OF_TRUST, NOTICE_OF_COMPLETION document types
- Added ParcelItem class and GetParcels() helper for multi-parcel deeds
- Added JurisdictionInfo for state/county-aware processing

v2.3.0 (January 2026)
- Added COMMITMENT_FOR_POLICY document type (title commitments, ALTA policies)
- Added JUDGEMENT document type (court judgments)
- Added LAST_WILL_AND_TESTAMENT document type
- Fixed nullable TotalPages in PageNumberingContext
- Added contract tests for SDK validation

v2.2.0 (January 2026)
- Added CONSENT and APPOINTMENT document types
- Added sourcePage support for TITLE_SEARCH_SUMMARY sections
- Improved table extraction for large documents
